Online dating scam involved a loan that was due November 5, 2020.  Skipped without payment.  Private investigator found no trace of him in the US. Reported to FTC, police, Match.com and Coinbase.  Daughters name is Sandy Hedrick.  In August she texted me from 434.284.6432 and then later the number no longer worked.  She also has 434.299.9101. Claims to be a Danish and American citizen with an accent.  We believe him to be Russian.  There is an alternate name with his photo on a Russian dating site and Russian Facebook with the name Damian Berkins and a different birthdate.  He said he was hired by Turkish investors to build a two-story hospital building in Istanbul Turkey and had to leave from LA.  While in LA we had a Skype video call.  I could see him, but the frame kept freezing.  I also saw a woman on that call.  The Skype number is hedrickj77@aol.com.  That is the one and only Skype call.  The rest of our contact was by email and phone calls.  He provided a confidential copy of the construction agreement with the hospital.  After he arrived in Turkey, he started asking for money for his project and I lent him $7,316 for which we both signed a loan agreement.  The money was sent through Coinbase in bitcoin - 4,811.52 on 10/13/20 and 2,505.07 on 10/14/20.  He disappeared around December 1st.  I cannot find his photos on any scammer site.  I believe he is Russian and running an online dating scam.  Smart cunning thief.  Would be nice if someone could trace this bitcoin wallet to him
